```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
hotel <- read_csv("data/hotel_saved.csv")
glimpse(hotel)
```

```{r data_summary, include=TRUE}
summary(hotel)
```
```{r data_cleaning1a, include=TRUE}
hotel_clean <- select(hotel, hotel, lead_time, is_canceled)
glimpse(hotel_clean)
```
```{r data_cleaning1b, include=TRUE}
hotel_clean %>%
  filter(is.na(hotel) | is.na(lead_time) | is.na(is_canceled))
```
```{r cancellation_rate, include=TRUE}
hotel_clean %>%
  group_by(hotel) %>%
  summarise(
    cancellation_rate = mean(is_canceled)
  )
```
```{r visualisation, include=TRUE}
hotel_rate <- hotel_clean %>%
  group_by(hotel) %>%
  summarise(
    cancellation_rate = mean(is_canceled)
  )

ggplot(hotel_rate, aes(x = hotel, y = cancellation_rate)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Cancellation Rate by Hotel Type",
    x = "Hotel Type",
    y = "Cancellation Rate"
  )
```
